scripts.check:dependencies: depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages apps/desktop/src --output-type err && knip --config knip.json --include "dependencies,unlisted,exports,types,cycles"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm check:imports && pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm build
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm verify:python && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.python:setup: uv sync --project python --frozen && uv run --project python python python/scripts/prepare_icu.py
scripts.build:python: pnpm python:setup && uv run --project python python python/scripts/build.py
scripts.package:win: pnpm build:python && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @testforge/desktop package:win
